title: Published constant-ring tensor computed on flat-term K-flat representatives
statement: Let J be a Grothendieck topology on a small category C in Type w, and A a commutative ring in Type w. Put R=constant_J(A) and use its module category [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor] and published K-flat derived tensor [lem-weil-pbc-kflat-fixed-tensor-triangulated]. For any K,L in D(Mod R), there exist flat-term K-flat cochain representatives P,N [lem-sf-cochain-tensor-model-rigidity], individual isomorphisms Q(P)≅K and Q(N)≅L, and an isomorphism K tensor^L L≅Q(total(P tensor N)). Here Q is the given derived localization and the cochain total tensor is precisely the recorded sheaf tensor. No boundedness or flatness assumption is imposed on K or L.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YT and 0G7E: flat-term K-flat resolutions and computation of derived tensor.

proof.text: Choose cochain preimages of both derived inputs. Resolve each by the existing independent-coefficient flat-term K-flat resolution theorem. Compose the localized quasi-isomorphisms with the preimage isomorphisms; the site tensor comparison identifies degreewise flatness with the site-flat predicate.

Apply cochain tensor-model rigidity to the two representatives. Compose the inverse of its comparison with the inverse of the published tensor applied to the two representative isomorphisms. Retain both individual isomorphisms. All three are actual isomorphisms, so this establishes the existential statement.

lean.statement:
theorem constantRingTensorRepresentatives {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type w) [CommRing A]
    [HasDerivedCategory (Modules J A)]
    (K L : DerivedCategory (Modules J A)) :
    ∃ P N : (SheafOfModules.cochainTensorFlatRepresentatives J (ring J A)).FullSubcategory,
      Nonempty ((((SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.derivedTensor (ring J A)).obj K).obj L) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          ((SheafOfModules.cochainTensorTotal J (ring J A)).obj (P.obj, N.obj))) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj ≅ K) ∧
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N.obj ≅ L)
